summary: On Day 3 of Season 9, Skratch demonstrates how gear optimizations and team adjustments can significantly increase Temporal Vortex scores up to 1.77 Billion total damage. By introducing Solmo into the Radiance Aura team and prioritizing broken gear pieces with high Crit Damage on Talethia over suboptimal full set bonuses, team output jumped by over 100 Million. Additionally, utilizing the Orb of the Dragon God artifact on mono-element teams provides a 15% team-wide damage boost. Skratch also shares full gear builds, stat targets, and skill timing setups for both his Radiance and Toxic Vortex teams.

meta_changes: High Crit Damage off-set pieces can outperform complete 3-piece set bonuses if the stat gain is significant.
Orb of the Dragon God artifact grants a massive 15% team-wide damage boost when running 5 heroes of the same element.
tips: Do not strictly stick to 3-piece set bonuses on primary DPS heroes if broken pieces provide dramatically higher Crit Damage.
Equip Orb of the Dragon God on a support hero in mono-element teams to secure an extra 15% damage increase.
Tune skill timings precise to 18-second recasts in Temporal Vortex to synchronize ultimate bursts with boss vulnerability windows.
